title: Myrobalan

inlines.v: MYROB'ALAN, noun [Latin myrobolanum; Gr. unguent, and a nut.] A dried fruit of the plum kind brought from the East Indies, of which there are several kinds, all slightly purgative and astringent, but not now used in medicine.
